mathematical_definition: mean(t_i - t_{i-1}) for consecutive tick market_timestamps in TickActivityTracker's trailing 60s ring buffer (self._times) -- average tick inter-arrival time in seconds
numerical_stability_notes: Stateful: derived from self._times, the same tick-timestamp deque that self._spreads is kept in lockstep with (both appended together on every update() call, both evicted together once a tick ages out of the trailing TICK_WINDOW_SEC=60.0s window). No division-by-zero risk (a simple mean of positive interarrival gaps). Genuinely new for Task 21 (spec section 7) -- the 6.7-year historical CSV has no tick-level timestamp series, so this feature has no historical analogue and cannot be backfilled.
missing_value_policy: None until at least 2 ticks are in the trailing 60s window (a single tick has no interarrival gap to average), never zero-filled
status_reason: no historical evidence exists or can exist for this feature; live data only since 2026-08-18 (Phase 2 live verification date)
